anarsa.description: Crisp fermented rice pastry soaked with jaggery or sugar, coated with poppy seeds and shallow fried in pure ghee.

ariselu.description: Authentic Andhra harvest festive delicacy made from fresh ground rice dough, dark organic jaggery, cardamom, and sesame seeds.

bandar_laddu.description: Geographical Indication (GI) tagged Andhra delicacy made from finely pounded gram flour boondi dough, sugar syrup, ghee, and roasted cashews.

basundi.description: Rich and creamy thickened whole milk dessert flavored with green cardamom, saffron strands, and slivered pistachios and almonds.

besan_cheela.description: Nutrient-dense savory Indian pancake prepared with spiced chickpea gram flour batter, diced onions, tomatoes, ginger, and fresh cilantro.

bhatura.description: Fluffy, deep-fried leavened sourdough bread made from refined flour, yogurt, and semolina, traditionally served hot with spicy Chole.

boondi.description: Crisp golden fried miniature pearls of spiced gram flour batter, used in raitas, chaats, or sweetened as festive treats.

chak_hao_kheer.description: Exotic royal purple pudding made from Manipur GI-tagged aromatic black rice (Chak-Hao) simmered with milk, cardamom, and roasted nuts.

cham_cham.description: Traditional Bengali sweet made from fresh artisanal curd cheese (chhena) cooked in light cardamom sugar syrup and garnished with desiccated coconut.

chhena_kheeri.description: Creamy delicacy from Coastal Odisha prepared with fine crumbles of fresh homemade chhena simmered slowly in sweetened saffron reduced milk.

chicken_razala.description: Royal Mughlai aromatic white chicken stew slow-simmered in rich cashew-poppy seed paste, whole dried red chilies, yogurt, and kewra water.

chicken_tikka_masala.description: Charred tandoori chicken tikka chunks simmered in a luscious, spiced tomato, cream, butter, and fenugreek gravy.

daal_baati_churma.description: Iconic Rajasthani culinary ensemble: baked wheat flour baatis dunked in desi ghee, served with spicy 5-lentil panchmel dal and sweet powdered churma.

daal_puri.description: Puffed whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with seasoned, roasted chana dal spiced with cumin, ajwain, and ginger, deep fried until golden.

dharwad_pedha.description: GI-tagged historic Karnataka dessert made from caramelized mawa (khoya) from Dharwad buffalo milk, sugar, cardamom, and coated with castor sugar.

doodhpak.description: Semi-thickened sweet rice pudding enriched with charoli (chironji seeds), saffron, nutmeg, and cardamom, paired traditionally with hot pooris.

double_ka_meetha.description: Nizami Hyderabadi specialty prepared by frying milk bread in pure ghee, soaking in fragrant saffron-cardamom sugar syrup, and drenching in thick rabri.

dum_aloo.description: Baby potatoes pricked and fried golden, then slow-cooked (dum) in a fragrant fennel, dry ginger, and Kashmiri chili yogurt gravy.

gavvalu.description: Traditional Andhra shell-shaped crisp pastries rolled on a wooden gavvala board, fried crisp, and coated in rich jaggery cardamom syrup.

imarti.description: Ornate circular floral sweet made from ground black gram (urad dal) batter piped into hot ghee, fried crisp, and soaked in cardamom saffron syrup.

kadhi_pakoda.description: Tangy, spiced yogurt and chickpea flour gravy simmered with fenugreek, mustard, and curry leaves, filled with crisp fried onion pakodas.

kajjikaya.description: Crisp crescent-shaped deep-fried pastry filled with sweet roasted semolina, desiccated coconut, sugar, cardamom, and sesame seeds.

kakinada_khaja.description: Iconic cylindrical layered pastry from Kakinada with a crisp multi-layered outer crust holding a burst of fragrant sugar syrup inside.

kalakand.description: Traditional granular milk fudge made by slow-simmering fresh chhena and sweetened condensed milk flavored with cardamom and pistachios.

karela_bharta.description: Boiled or roasted bitter gourd mashed with pungent mustard oil, green chilies, onions, garlic, and sea salt.

kofta.description: Delicate dumplings made from paneer, potato, or bottle gourd fried golden and served in a creamy cashew tomato spiced gravy.

kuzhi_paniyaram.description: Crisp-on-the-outside, fluffy-inside fermented rice-lentil dumplings cooked in a special cast iron dimpled pan, tempered with mustard, onions, and curry leaves.

lassi.description: Refreshing traditional Punjabi blended yogurt beverage churned with ice, cardamom, saffron, and a dollop of fresh clotted cream (malai).

ledikeni.description: Historic 19th-century Kolkata delicacy crafted by Bhim Chandra Nag: fried chhena dumplings flavored with cardamom and soaked in light sugar syrup.

litti_chokha.description: Whole wheat balls stuffed with spiced roasted gram flour (sattu), baked over coal fire, dipped in desi ghee, and served with mashed brinjal-tomato chokha.

lyangcha.description: Famous Shaktigarh cylindrical fried sweet made from artisanal chhena and khoya dough, deep-fried dark and steeped in cardamom sugar syrup.

maach_jhol.description: Comforting light Bengali fish curry cooked with Rohu or Katla fish steaks, potatoes, pointed gourd, turmeric, and freshly ground mustard and kalonji.

makki_di_roti_sarson_da_saag.canonical_name: Makki di Roti & Sarson da Saag
makki_di_roti_sarson_da_saag.description: Quintessential Punjabi winter feast: rustic unleavened yellow cornmeal flatbread paired with slow-cooked spiced mustard greens, spinach, and white butter.

malapua.description: Fried spiced pancake prepared from flour, semolina, mashed banana, and fennel seeds, soaked in rich saffron syrup and topped with pistachios.

misi_roti.description: Nutritious North Indian flatbread made by blending whole wheat flour and chickpea gram flour with ajwain, kasuri methi, turmeric, and onions.

misti_doi.description: Celebrated Bengali fermented sweet yogurt set in earthen clay pots with caramelized jaggery or palm sugar, giving it a distinctive nutty blush.

navrattan_korma.description: Luxurious Mughlai curry containing nine assorted vegetables, paneer, fruits, and nuts in a velvety sweet-savory cashew and poppy seed gravy.

pithe.description: Artisanal winter harvest treat: thin rice flour crepes rolled with a luscious filling of fresh coconut, khoya, and date palm jaggery (nolen gur).

poornalu.description: Divine Andhra festive sweet: sphere of cooked chana dal, jaggery, and cardamom encased in a crisp fermented urad-rice batter and golden fried.

pootharekulu.description: GI-tagged paper-thin edible rice starch wafer sheets hand-layered with pure ghee, powdered sugar or jaggery, and chopped dry fruits.

qubani_ka_meetha.description: Royal Hyderabadi delicacy prepared from dried apricots stewed slowly with sugar, cardamom, and garnished with apricot almond kernels and clotted cream.

sandesh.description: Refined Bengali dessert made from lightly kneaded fresh artisanal chhena gently cooked with date palm jaggery or sugar, shaped into delicate molds.

shankarpali.description: Crisp diamond-cut snack prepared from spiced flour dough sweetened with sugar or jaggery, flavored with cardamom, and fried until golden.

sheer_korma.description: Festive Eid dessert made by roasting fine vermicelli in ghee, slow-simmering in rich milk with dried dates, saffron, cardamom, and charoli nuts.

sheera.description: Traditional roasted semolina pudding cooked in pure ghee, cardamom milk, and sugar, garnished with golden raisins and toasted cashews.

sohan_halwa.description: Dense, chewy caramelized confection made from sprouted wheat flour (angoori), milk, sugar, saffron, and loaded with almonds and pistachios.

sohan_papdi.description: Delicate, crisp, multi-fibered cotton candy-like sweet made from gram flour, refined flour, ghee, sugar syrup, and cardamom.

sutar_feni.description: Gossamer thread-like shredded sweet made from roasted all-purpose flour strings in ghee, steeped in sugar syrup and topped with pistachios.

unni_appam.description: Beloved Kerala snack made from roasted rice flour, ripe bananas, dark jaggery, roasted coconut bits, cardamom, and fried in ghee appakarai.

rolls.description: Flaky paratha or crisp pastry wrapped around spicy paneer, egg, or sauteed vegetables with tangy mint-chili chutney and pickled onions.

aloo_matar.description: Comforting North Indian curry cooked with tender diced potatoes, sweet green peas, tomatoes, ginger, and aromatic spices.

aloo_shimla_mirch.description: Flavorful home-style stir fry of crisp green bell peppers and golden pan-roasted potatoes tossed with cumin, coriander, and amchur.

paneer_butter_masala.description: Soft artisanal cottage cheese cubes simmered in a velvety smooth tomato-butter sauce enriched with cashew cream and fragrant dried fenugreek leaves.

ras_malai.description: Melt-in-mouth flattened chhena discs poached and immersed in chilled, sweetened, saffron-cardamom clotted milk garnished with pistachios.

dosa.description: Crisp golden fermented rice and black gram crepe roasted on a hot tawa with sesame oil or ghee, served with coconut chutney and sambar.

pakoda.description: Crisp golden deep-fried vegetable fritters made by dipping sliced onions, potatoes, or spinach in spiced chickpea gram flour batter.
